claims.text: The PMO list of former Prime Ministers includes 'K.B.E Fatafehi Tu'ipelehake ( 1965 – 1991 )'.
claims.uncertainty: A retrospective list with year precision only. It gives no appointment or retirement day and is not an instrument; no structured period is stored because the list gives years, not days. Taken on its own, it does not show that he was still in office on 1 January 1990.

claims.text: The same list gives 'Baron Vaea ( 1991 – 2000 )' and 'HRH . Prince 'Uukalala Lavaka Ata ( 2000 – 2006 )' (spelling as printed).
claims.uncertainty: Year precision only. The PMO's own 2015 list gives Vaea 1991-1999 (to_pmo_former_pms_2015_list), so the end year conflicts.

claims.text: The same list gives 'Dr. Feleti Sevele ( 2006 – 2010 )', 'Lord Tu'ivakano ( 2010 – 2014 )', 'Hon. Samiuela 'Akilisi Pohiva (2015-2019)' and 'Hon. Rev. Dr. Pohiva Tu'i'onetoa (2020 – 2021)'.
claims.uncertainty: These year ranges disagree with dated PMO releases: Pohiva's appointment audience was on 30 December 2014 (to_pohiva_royal_appointment_20141230), and Tu'i'onetoa was appointed on 8 October 2019 (to_tuionetoa_royal_appointment_20191008). The list is therefore not used for any start or end date; it is kept on the role only as the reason those ranges are not used.

scope_note: Retrospective list of former Prime Ministers on the live PMO site, read on 2026-09-22, after the 7 September 2026 cutoff. The page carries no publication or revision date (the PMO site search lists it under 2 November 2019) and has been edited since, because it names a 2025 holder; only the entries for holders before 2020 are used, and the later entries (Hu'akavameiliku 2021 – 2024 and Eke 2025) are not imported. Year precision only. Portrait images are not reused.
